purpose: Diagnose whether the frozen Q5.1 TTF-C statistic has a positive geometry-conditioned expectation under independent private relation phases, after phase randomness is averaged out.

fixed_estimator.definition: exact frozen Q5.1 TTF-C: training coupling turnover length-orthogonalized within system; held-out coupling turnover raw; held-out score ordinary Spearman

cells.description: All 40 systems share the same 60-point evenly spaced circular geometry up to one world-level global rotation; no clustering, truncation, or missingness heterogeneity.
Fresh Q5 matched heterogeneous geometry; responses from the simulator are discarded and replaced by independent private phase redraws.
Fresh Q5 shifted train/eval geometry; simulator responses are discarded and replaced by independent private phase redraws.

predeclared_mechanism_tests.matched_conditional_null_bias: Supported iff the lower 95% bootstrap bound of the across-geometry mean of each geometry world's phase-averaged Q5.1 TTF-C score is > 0 on DCN_MATCHED.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.shifted_conditional_null_bias: Same criterion on DCN_SHIFTED; reported separately.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.matched_heterogeneity_amplification: Supported iff the lower 95% bootstrap bound of mean(DCN_MATCHED) - mean(DCN_HOMOGENEOUS) is > 0 using independent geometry-world bootstrap resampling.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.shifted_heterogeneity_amplification: Supported iff the lower 95% bootstrap bound of mean(DCN_SHIFTED) - mean(DCN_HOMOGENEOUS) is > 0.
predeclared_mechanism_tests.primary_geometry_conditioned_null_bias: Supported iff matched_conditional_null_bias AND matched_heterogeneity_amplification are both supported. This is a mechanism diagnosis only, not a qualification or repair gate.

per_cell: mean Monte Carlo SE of each geometry-conditioned mean
mean fraction of phase redraw scores above zero

terminal_rule.if_supported: Freeze only the geometry-conditioned null-bias diagnosis. Any correction must be defined later in a newly named prospective development family with fresh worlds; these geometry worlds and phase redraws may not be used to tune it.
terminal_rule.if_not_supported: Freeze the negative diagnosis and do not tune phase-centering, geometry-conditioned offsets, or private-null expectation corrections on these worlds.
